pageTitle: Klacks for Facility & Cleaning Services | Site Routes & Teams

hero.subtitle: Klacks assigns sites, routes, and rotating teams efficiently — with the right qualifications and time windows. Routes are optimized automatically, so no time is lost on the road.
hero.screenshotAlt: Klacks schedule grid for cleaning teams and sites
hero.screenshotCaption: Screenshot shown in German — the app itself is also available in English.

items.title: Many sites, many routes
items.text: Teams drive from site to site. Poor routes cost time, mileage, and money every single day.

items.title: Rotating teams
items.text: Who's working where today? Sick leave, vacation, and temp staff turn scheduling into a daily puzzle.

items.title: Tight time windows
items.text: Some sites are only accessible at specific times — scheduling has to hit that window exactly.

solutions.title: How Klacks lightens the load for facility services
solutions.subtitle: From the optimized route to the flexible team — it all works together.

items.title: Site routes optimized
items.text: Klacks sequences sites so distances stay short — by car, bike, or on foot.

items.title: Teams scheduled flexibly
items.text: Changing crews, temp staff, and vacation: Klacks keeps track of it all and suggests the right assignments.

items.title: Time windows respected
items.text: Klacks automatically schedules sites that are only accessible in the morning or evening into the right window.

items.title: The right qualifications
items.text: Specialized cleaning, machinery, secure areas: only appropriately qualified staff get scheduled.

items.title: Klacksy schedules by voice
items.text: “Schedule the sites in district 4 for tomorrow morning” is enough — Klacksy optimizes the route and the team.

items.title: Absences covered fast
items.text: If someone drops out, Klacks immediately shows who's available and which route fits best.

cta.title: Experience Klacks in your cleaning business
cta.text: In a personal demo, we'll show you how Klacks handles routes, teams, and time windows for you.
